answer: Invariant: no agent mints voting weight without locking scarce lotus behind a live vine link, so sybil cost scales with capital, not key generation. Two conditions hold it: registration must graft onto an existing vine, where a member co-signs and posts a slashable bond, making fake clusters expensive; and rewards vest only after a nebula round, random committee sampling across the whole graph, so isolated rings get diluted and slashed before payout.
